What are the Best Solar Incentives for Arizona Homeowners in 2026?

Azizona offers several solar incentives for homeowners, making it an ideal location for those looking to switch to renewable energy. The most notable incentives include the Solar Energy Industries Association's (SEIA) tax credits and the Arizona Commerce Authority's rebate program.

Arizona Net Metering Law

The Arizona Public Service Company (APS) and other utility companies in Arizona offer net metering, which allows homeowners to sell excess energy back to the grid. This program helps offset energy bills and provides a credit for excess energy produced.

Arizona Solar Tax Credits

The SEIA offers tax credits of up to 30% of the total cost of a solar panel system, making it a significant incentive for Arizona homeowners. Additionally, the state's tax credit program provides a 10% credit of the total cost.
